appendDesc.RPC and Security: Also covers SecurityManager (authentication, ACLs and secret handling) and SSLOptions.
appendDesc.Job and Task Scheduler: Also covers barrier execution mode (BarrierCoordinator, BarrierTaskContext) and the task end reasons reported to the scheduler.

tour.title: Heartbeats and cleanup
tour.description: Executors report to the driver on a schedule: Heartbeater sends a heartbeat with task metrics, and the driver side HeartbeatReceiver answers, and marks executors dead when they stay silent. ContextCleaner runs on the driver and removes shuffle files, broadcasts, accumulators and cached RDDs once the objects that referred to them are garbage collected.

tour.title: Barrier execution mode and task end reasons
tour.description: In barrier mode all tasks of a stage start together and can synchronize. BarrierTaskContext gives a task barrier() and allGather(), and BarrierCoordinator on the driver collects the requests. When a task ends, a TaskEndReason (Success, FetchFailed, ExceptionFailure, TaskKilled and others) tells the scheduler what to do next.
